notes: Normalized from raw/therow.{json,html,css} + desktop/mobile screenshots + 11 scroll frames. TYPE: px sizes converted at 16px root. The real ladder is 13px body / 14px default / 16px inputs / 24px max; 10-12px are legal + label sizes. Fractional sizes in the raw profile (13.008px, 12.992px, 14.4px, 11.05px) are rem-rounding artifacts from third-party widgets and were dropped. No h1 exists on the page; `fluid_type: false` and body stays 13px at both 1440px and 390px, so there is no responsive type axis to record. `1.0625rem` (17px) is the wordmark only, at ~0.29em tracking (5px) uppercase — that tracking value is a display device, not a body token. Weight 700 appears 35 times and is entirely third-party chrome; treat this as a single-weight system. COLOR: no accent exists — the photograph is the accent, so `accent` is set to ink rather than invented. Ink is a warm near-black (#1c1b1b), never #000. `sale`/`error` are the only chromatic values and are strictly semantic. A stray link blue (#3860be) and a green (#50ae88) appear only inside embedded third-party widgets and were excluded. `surface` #f8f8f8 is a low-frequency (4 nodes) input/hover ground, included because it is the system's only non-white surface. `color.dark` is OMITTED: craft.theme.supportsDark is false and the profile's `theme.dark` block is a white-on-white echo of the light theme, not a real dark palette. SPACE: base is 5px. The raw profile's 5.25px / 8.75px / 10.5px are rem-derived halves of that unit; rounded to 5/9/10 for reuse. 60/75px are product-grid gutters; 110px is the footer band. RADIUS/SHADOW: radius 2px reads as square (1px, 2.5px, 3px collapsed into it); 20px/17px/50px are pill-shaped chips and buttons in embedded widgets. Every shadow in the sheet belongs to a drawer or modal — no content surface is elevated, and there are ZERO gradients on the page. Elevation is a modality signal here, not decoration. MOTION: `scroll_effects` is deliberately near-empty. The raw profile reports 8 scroll effects, all `kind: pin` — these are the position:fixed drawer/overlay elements being misread as pinned layers, not scroll choreography. The 11-frame sequence shows NO content-plane movement: nothing reveals, scales, parallaxes, or recolors; the page simply scrolls under a sticky header. `Rellax` is detected in the bundle but no `data-rellax`/`.rellax` element exists in the DOM, so no parallax is claimed. The one real in-view effect is the header's transparent→solid flip, evidenced by the single IntersectionObserver (threshold [0,0.1,0.5,0.9,1], rootMargin '0px 0px -90% 0px') plus the `--header-is-transparent` / `--enable-header-negative-margin` 0-or-1 calc flags; the frames don't scroll far enough to capture the flip itself. Of the 19 @keyframes, only three are the theme's own (aniShow/aniHide = opacity 0<->1; animateMenuOpen = fade + 1.5rem rise); the rest are third-party spinners, skeletons, and the cookie banner. `cubic-bezier(0.645,0.045,0.355,1)` is the theme's exposed `--drawer-transition-timing`. The 800ms duration and the other two beziers appear only in embedded widgets. REDUCED MOTION: recorded as `not-respected`, overriding the probe's `respectsReducedMotion: true`. That flag is a false positive — the single `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rule in the whole 5331-line bundle belongs to a third-party geolocation modal. The theme's own 450-500ms drawers, fades, and menu rise are ungated. A11Y: focus flag omitted rather than guessed — the theme defines no :focus-visible rule of its own (the only two in the bundle are third-party), while the probe reports focus_visible: true. 171 of 410 interactive elements are under 44px. `alt-coverage-high` is technically true (img_alt_ratio 1.0 across 6 images) but the hero carries alt="" under an empty , leaving the page's primary action unlabeled.
